meta.source: legos-factory-v2 frontend/src/styles/tokens.css + global.css, re-skinned on the Emerald Depth palette

tokens.name: emerald-950
tokens.usage: Palette root. Ink in light, canvas in dark. Never a fill for small text grounds in dark.

tokens.name: emerald-900
tokens.usage: Palette. Primary hover in light, surface in dark.

tokens.name: emerald-800
tokens.usage: Palette. The brand emerald: primary buttons, user bubbles, active pill nav.

tokens.name: emerald-700
tokens.usage: Palette. Accent text, focus ring, links in light; hairlines in dark.

tokens.name: emerald-300
tokens.usage: Palette. Sage: charts, progress fills, brand in dark. Not a text colour on white (2.3:1).

tokens.name: emerald-100
tokens.usage: Palette. Mint tint: active nav ground, highlights, text on emerald-800.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards (was --bg).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, composer, assistant bubbles (was --panel).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover rows, segmented track, search fields, code blocks (was --panel2).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of cards and rows (was --line). Decorative, not a control edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes. 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps on canvas, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, user message bubble, selected segment.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, active tab text, focus ring, selected icon on surface or tint.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Selected nav row, active chip, highlighted message ground. Text on it: accent or ink.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Primary series.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series and soft bars. 2.3:1 on white in light: always paired with a value label, never the only cue.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Track / third series / bar backgrounds.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, passed, merged: text and dots on success-soft or surface.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success pills.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs your input, waiting: text on warning-soft or surface (from the codebase's orange pill).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning pills and gates awaiting a human.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, blocked, destructive: text on danger-soft or surface (was --red).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of danger pills.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Running, informational: text on info-soft or surface.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of info pills.

tokens.name: crew-foreman
tokens.usage: Foreman identity fill (orchestration). Avatars and dots only, never text.

tokens.name: crew-architect
tokens.usage: Architect identity fill (planning, spec review). Fill only.

tokens.name: crew-builder
tokens.usage: Builder identity fill (implementation). Fill only.

tokens.name: crew-inspector
tokens.usage: Inspector identity fill (code & test review). Fill only.

tokens.name: crew-cataloger
tokens.usage: Cataloger identity fill (second brain). Fill only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ask your agents to research, write or build something.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, file paths, tool arguments in chat.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button gap, chip gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, nav item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards, stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page top margin, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Pills, counts, segmented inner buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, nav rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tool steps, inline gates, side panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and panels (was --radius).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: App frame, composer, message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill nav, chips, avatars, send button.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, floating composer (was --shadow).

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on inputs and buttons.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Left navigation rail (was --rail).

tokens.name: thread-width
tokens.usage: Max width of a chat thread and its composer.

tokens.usage: Default button height.

tokens.usage: Small button height.
